result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one major layout truncation issue and one minor missing element.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge — both the image and the restaurant name are truncated, making it unclear this is a scrollable carousel.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible scroll indicator, partial card peek with consistent padding, or an arrow button to signal horizontal scrollability. Ensure the truncated text shows an ellipsis properly and the card image is not clipped awkwardly.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section does not show a delivery fee, unlike the other two cards which display '€0.90 delivery' and '€1.90 delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Display the delivery fee consistently across all restaurant cards, or explicitly show '€0 delivery' or 'Free delivery' if applicable to maintain visual consistency.
